## fashion_flatlay_board

> Styled flatlay of garments and accessories arranged on a surface for editorial use.

**Artifact:** `infographic`, `1024x1024`, aspect `1:1`
**Demo vars:** `templates/fashion/_vars_examples/fashion_flatlay_board.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A square flatlay composition photographed straight down on warm raw-linen tablecloth over a wooden studio bench, themed around Quiet Coastal Weekend. Three styled garment-and-accessory groupings are arranged across the surface, each anchored by one of Cropped linen overshirt, oat, Pleated cotton trouser, sand, and Woven leather slide, tan. The flatlay reads as deliberately styled rather than randomly dropped, with breathing room between groupings.
[2. Action] All items are static — flatlay is by definition a still life. The arrangement guides the eye in a soft Z across the frame: upper-left grouping leads the reader, the central grouping anchors, the lower-right grouping releases. Folds, draping, and object overlap are intentional, never tangled.
[3. Scene] The styling surface is described by warm raw-linen tablecloth over a wooden studio bench, lit by a single soft overhead daylight source from camera-top so shadows fall gently downward. Ambient light is even; no theatrical spotlight, no colored gels. Around the edges, the surface extends to the frame border with no visible studio context.
[4. Composition] Square 1:1 top-down frame. The surface fills 100% of the canvas. The three groupings sit on the corners of an internal triangle, keeping the geometric center loose and visually quiet. A small theme label sits flush against the top edge, and three discreet item callouts sit near each grouping's outermost garment. Even margins of approximately 4% on all sides.
[5. Style] Contemporary editorial flatlay aesthetic — clean, considered, tactile. Palette tied to the natural colors of the garments against a calm surface tone. Type system uses a small-cap editorial sans for theme and item labels, set in restrained weight. Fabric texture, leather grain, and metal highlights must read as photographed objects, not rendered ones. No HDR, no neon, no gradient backdrops.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- theme_label: "Quiet Coastal Weekend"
- item1: "Cropped linen overshirt, oat"
- item2: "Pleated cotton trouser, sand"
- item3: "Woven leather slide, tan"

NO: real famous brand logos, copyrighted designer monograms, real-celebrity likeness, HDR oversaturation, rainbow palette, lens flare, watermarks, cluttered arrangement, 3D rendered plastic surfaces, clip-art icons, cinematic teal-orange grading, busy patterned backdrops competing with garments
```

## fashion_lookbook_page

> Editorial lookbook page — single-look hero shot with brand caption and item credits.

**Artifact:** `poster`, `1024x1280`, aspect `4:5`
**Demo vars:** `templates/fashion/_vars_examples/fashion_lookbook_page.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A single-page editorial lookbook layout for Pomelo Press Atelier, presenting Look 07 from the Resort 2026 collection. The layout is built around one full-figure hero photograph of a model wearing ivory linen blazer, fluted silk trouser, woven raffia sandal. The figure occupies the dominant left two- thirds of the page; a calm typographic margin runs down the right.
[2. Action] The model holds a held, considered pose typical of a lookbook plate — body angled three-quarters, weight on one leg, one hand relaxed, the other resting near the garment. The intent is to showcase silhouette, fabric drape, and styling detail rather than to perform editorial drama. Eyes look just past the camera.
[3. Scene] A controlled studio environment with a single seamless backdrop in a warm chalk or putty tone, lit to render fabric texture truthfully. No props, no decorative furniture, no audience. Floor grades softly into the backdrop with no visible seam. The air feels still; nothing distracts from the look.
[4. Composition] Vertical 4:5 page. The hero photograph crops a few centimeters above the head and at mid-calf, occupying the left two-thirds of the canvas. The right third is a clean typographic column: the brand wordmark sits high, the season tag below, the look number is set in a large display numeral, and a single item-list paragraph runs as the lowest text element. Generous outer page margins.
[5. Style] Quiet contemporary lookbook aesthetic. Palette restrained to paper, ink, and the natural colors of the garments themselves. Type system: a refined modern serif for the brand wordmark and an editorial sans-serif for season, look number, and item list. Fabric must read as photographed cloth, not rendered cloth. Soft, even key light with quiet falloff; no theatrical fashion lighting, no neon, no gradient backdrops.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- brand_name: "Pomelo Press Atelier"
- season: "Resort 2026"
- look_no: "Look 07"
- item_list: "ivory linen blazer, fluted silk trouser, woven raffia sandal"

NO: real-celebrity likeness, real famous brand logos, copyrighted house monograms, HDR oversaturation, rainbow palette, busy printed backdrops, lens flare, watermarks, photoshop-flattened fabric texture, clip-art icons, heavy beauty retouching, cinematic teal-orange grading
```

## fashion_runway_poster

> Vertical runway / show poster — brutalist editorial fashion-week announcement.

**Artifact:** `poster`, `1088x1920`, aspect `9:16`
**Demo vars:** `templates/fashion/_vars_examples/fashion_runway_poster.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A vertical runway-show poster announcing the Northwind Atelier Autumn / Winter 2026 presentation in Antwerp on 14 March 2026, 20:00. The poster is conceived as a brutalist editorial print: a single elongated figure silhouette runs the full height of the canvas, the typography sits against that figure as a hard counterweight, no decorative ornament.
[2. Action] The poster is static. The depicted figure stands frontally, cropped at the brow and mid-shin, draped in a single architectural look from the collection. No motion, no walking pose, no audience. The viewer's eye travels from the oversized brand wordmark at the top, down the figure's silhouette, to the location-and-date plate at the bottom.
[3. Scene] A bare environment: a single tonal wall — concrete grey, ink black, or chalk white — with no furniture, no scenography, no secondary figures. Light comes from a single hard source camera- top, casting a clean compressed shadow at the figure's feet. The atmosphere is severe and architectural rather than romantic.
[4. Composition] Vertical 9:16 frame. Title zone (~18%) at the top holds the brand wordmark set very large with tight tracking. Figure zone (~64%) in the middle holds the silhouette running full-bleed left to right, occupying the central column. Footer zone (~12%) at the bottom holds the season label and the location-date plate, typeset small and in a contrasting weight. Generous outer margins.
[5. Style] Brutalist editorial fashion-poster aesthetic — Helmut Lang / Margiela invitation card sensibility. Typographic treatment dominates: a heavy condensed sans for the brand wordmark, a plain sans-serif at small size for footer text. Palette is severely restricted: a single ink color against a single paper color, with at most one muted accent. No gradients, no neon, no photographic flourish, no decorative ornament.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- brand_name: "Northwind Atelier"
- season: "Autumn / Winter 2026"
- location_date: "Antwerp, 14 March 2026, 20:00"

NO: real famous brand logos, copyrighted house monograms, real-celebrity likeness, HDR oversaturation, rainbow palette, lens flare, watermarks, decorative floral ornament, busy stock-photo collage, 3D rendered plastic, heavy beauty retouching, cinematic teal-orange grading
```
